questions.stem: What is the relative formula mass (Mr) of magnesium nitrate, Mg(NO₃)₂? (Ar: Mg = 24, N = 14, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Mg(NO₃)₂ contains 1 Mg, 2 N, and 6 O (the subscript 3 for oxygen is multiplied by the 2 outside the bracket). Mr = (1 × 24) + (2 × 14) + (6 × 16) = 24 + 28 + 96 = 148.

questions.stem: Which statement about relative atomic mass (Ar) and relative formula mass (Mr) is correct?

options.text: Both Ar and Mr are measured in grams
Ar is measured in grams, but Mr has no units
Neither Ar nor Mr has units because they are ratios
Mr is measured in grams per mole

questions.explanation: Both Ar and Mr are relative values — they are ratios compared to 1/12 of the mass of a carbon-12 atom. Because they are ratios, they have no units. The molar mass (in g/mol) is numerically equal to Mr but does carry units.
